== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Lichborn are a species characterized by their gray skin and eyes that emit a green light. Originally custom-designed by humans to be flawless, they possess an appearance that is almost universally considered beautiful by human standards. This physical perfection and natural good looks have allowed members of the species to find success in political roles and within organizations like [[the Advocates]]. While they can accumulate scars like human warriors, some individuals possess a flame of resurrection that prevents such wear and tear. They also possess an unnatural resilience, though they do not age in the same manner as humans. The Lichborn homeworld is Dornoth IV{{!}}Dornoth Four, a planet inhabited by approximately one hundred million people, with billions more living on surrounding space stations. The species is known to thrive in hostile environments that would be uninhabitable for others. Their culture and technology reflect their identity, specifically through their spacecraft, which feature skeletal designs and are illuminated by green light. Historically, the Lichborn have been engaged in a multi-generational conflict with [[Karosha]]. Members of the species are capable of producing hybrids, such as those possessing both human and Lichborn heritage. They also utilize a distinct language and have been known to employ [[Aethertech]] in their armor, weaponry, and various technological implements.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Lichborn are a people originating from their own homeworld, characterized by gray skin and eyes that shine with green light. These individuals possess specific marks within their eyes and are considered almost universally beautiful by human standards. While they find a sense of home in hostile hellscapes, the Lichborn are currently engaged in a war against the Karoshan{{!}}Karoshans. Beyond their biological identity, the name also refers to a system that exports thought-conduction alloys.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Lichborn are a group of people who have been engaged in a generational war against [[Karosha]]. Within this race, [[Moonmaster]] possesses Lichborn heritage as a half-Lichborn. During his journey, [[Starhammer]] contemplates the idea that his savior could be a member of this group. This entity is later identified as a woman clad in [[Aethertech armor]], though a Lichborn man was also noted to be present during the encounter.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Lichborn are one of the five species of intelligent beings found throughout the galaxy. As a distinct race, they possess the unique ability to survive certain levels of physical damage. Their likeness can be seen depicted in statues of arena fighters, and their culture is further reflected in the royal dramas displayed on holographic screens. During events at the landing site, a [[Lichborn woman]] was observed arriving.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Hailing from their homeworld of [[Dornoth IV]], the Lichborn are a species characterized by near-flawless looks and gray skin. This group, which includes individuals such as [[Nera Jesh]], functions as a fleet that emerges from subspace warps and maintains a history of utilizing power armor. As manufacturers of various ships and life-pods, they are capable of encircling others in moments of anger. Notable members include a gray-streaked haired woman seen in the hangar and Sola Kalter{{!}}Sola, who possesses a green Lichborn eye.}}
